name: Apc1 → Set Passive Mode
description: This action puts the sensor into passive measurement mode. In passive mode, the sensor stops sending data frames automatically. Readings are only transmitted when requested with [`apc1.request_measurement`](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/apc1/#apc1-request_measurement-action).
